answer_1.quote: We train dedicated Feedback and Edit models with HelpSteer3 data that can be used at inference time to improve model responses to open-ended general-domain tasks.
answer_1.outputs: Generated responses, feedback, and edited responses

answer_2.quote: we measure the helpfulness of models to general-domain prompts using three popular metrics: AlpacaEval 2.0 Length Controlled (Dubois et al., 2024), GPT-4-Turbo MT Bench (Zheng et al., 2023) and Arena Hard (Li et al., 2024).

answer_3.quote: For MT Bench, responses are evaluated by GPT-4-0125-Preview to give a score between 1 and 10; for Arena Hard, model responses are compared with responses from GPT-4-0314 using GPT-4-1106-preview judge to calculate a win-rate.

answer_4.quote: we ask 3 in-house annotators to independently annotate each prompt on whether they prefer a response from Llama-3.1-Nemotron-70B-Instruct or the same model with an optimally-scaled Feedback-Edit ITS system
